title.en: 5.1 Need for external ADC in an 8051 system

h.en: Need for external ADC in an 8051 system

body.en:
Definition

Analog-to-digital conversion maps a continuous input quantity into finite digital codes so software can process a conditioned sensor signal.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Classic 8051 has digital I/O,no internal ADC;reading a pin only yields a logic state,not an8-bit measurement.Add sensor conditioning,range protection/reference,ADC clock and interface control.
  • Successive approximation resolves bits by comparing a trial DAC level with input;ADC0804 exposes the result on a parallel bus.Amultiplexer shares one ADC among channels but does not perform conversion itself.
  • After changing a multiplexer,allow settling and maintain source stability during conversion;channel order,calibration and timestamps matter in a real acquisition system.
Hysteresis purpose?

Separate ON/OFFthresholds reduce chatter around a single boundary.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • Classic 8051માં digital I/O છે,internal ADC નથી.Pin read માત્ર logic state આપે,8-bit measurement નહીં.Sensor conditioning,range protection/reference,clock/interface ઉમેરો.
  • Successive approximation trial DAC level/input compare કરીને bits નક્કી કરે;ADC0804 parallel bus પર result આપે.Multiplexer એક ADC channels વચ્ચે share કરે,પોતે conversion નથી કરતું.

Hysteresis શા માટે?

અલગ ON/OFF thresholds single boundary પાસે chatter ઘટાડે.

Definition

A temperature-control system compares a measured temperature with defined limits and commands an actuator to maintain a desired operating band with safe fault behaviour.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Assumed demonstration is cooling-only:fan ONat35°C,OFFat33°C,retain previous state between thresholds.This hysteresis prevents chatter around one boundary;it is not a complete PIDcontroller.

h.en: UART baud generation and MAX232 level conversion
h.gu: UART Baud generation તથા MAX232 Level conversion

body.en:
Definition

UART transmits asynchronous serial frames at an agreed baud rate;MAX232 converts compatible logic-level signals to/from true RS-232electrical levels and does not perform ADC conversion.

Assumptions,ordered derivation and checks

  1. With11.0592MHzclassic12T,Timer1 Mode2,SMOD=0:baud=fosc/[384(256−TH1)].For9600baud,256−TH1=3,so TH1=FDH.Set SCON=50Hfor Mode1 UART with receive enabled.
  2. Derivation:timer overflow=fosc/[12(256−TH1)];UART Mode1 divides it by32when SMOD=0,so baud=fosc/[384(256−TH1)].Do not reuse the12MHztimer assumption without calculating baud error.
  3. Write SBUFthen wait/handle TIand clear it;read received SBUFwhen RIis set and clear RI.Serial interrupt shares RI/TI,so service both causes.Terminal uses matched baud,data/parity/stop settings.
  4. An ordinary MAX232 uses5Vsupply and its specified charge-pump capacitors,not an external±12Vrequirement.Capacitor values differ for MAX232/MAX232 Avariants;USB-to-TTLand USB-to-RS-232cables are not interchangeable.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

UART agreed baud પર asynchronous frames મોકલે;MAX232 logic/true RS-232 levels ફેરવે,ADC conversion નથી કરતું.

ધારણાઓ,ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation તથા ચકાસણી

  1. 11.0592MHz12T,Timer1 Mode2/SMOD=0માં baud=fosc/[384(256−TH1)].9600 માટે256−TH1=3/TH1=FDH.SCON=50Hથી Mode1 receive-enabled UART મળે.
  2. Derivation:timer overflow=fosc/[12(256−TH1)];SMOD=0માં UART Mode1 તેને32થી ભાગે,તેથી baud=fosc/[384(256−TH1)].Baud error ગણ્યા વિના12MHz assumption નલો.
  3. SBUF write પછી TI handle/clear;RI set હોય ત્યારે SBUF read/RI clear કરો.Serial ISRમાં બંને causes handle કરો.Terminal baud,data/parity/stop match રાખો.
  4. Ordinary MAX232 5V/ specified charge-pump capacitors વાપરે,external±12V જરૂર નથી.MAX232/MAX232 A caps અલગ;USB-to-TTL/USB-to-RS-232 interchangeable નથી.

title.en: 5.4 GSM odem security system:construction and working

h.en: GSM odem security system:construction and working

body.en:
Definition

A GSM security application detects a defined event and requests a notification through a compatible modem;successful detection and successful message delivery are separate states.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Construction:debounced switch/supervised input,8051 controller,compatible UART level interface,properly powered GSM odem and low-voltage alarm/relay driver.SIM/network/module commands must match the hardware.
  • Working:initialise alarm OFF,check modem response,detect/debounce an authorised test event,request text mode/wait prompt,send test message,check response and flag success/failure with bounded timeouts.
  • Raw modem UART may be2.8Vor3.3Vand require suitable level translation;MAX232 is only for an actual RS-232interface.Modem transmit bursts require the manufacturer-rated separate supply/decoupling,not a GPIO power pin.
  • SMSis not a guaranteed real-time or life-safety path.Handle no network,wrong SIM,reset,timeout and repeated events;use authorised test numbers only.No mains relay load or real security certification is implied.

Complete standalone Keil C51 example

11.0592 MHz classic12T;Timer0 network waits nominal1/5/30s plus overhead;debounce loop not calibrated

#include <reg51.h>
typedef unsigned char u8;
typedef unsigned int u16;
/* UART programs below require 11.0592 MHz classic12T, not the 12 MHz delay assumption. */
void uart_init(void) {
    TR1=0; PCON &= 0x7F; TMOD=(TMOD&0x0F)|0x20;
    TH1=0xFD; TL1=0xFD; SCON=0x50; TI=0; RI=0; TR1=1;
}
u8 uart_put(u8 x) {
    u16 timeout=60000u; TI=0; SBUF=x;
    while (!TI && timeout) --timeout;
    if (!timeout) return 0; TI=0; return 1;
}
u8 uart_text(char *s) { while (*s) if (!uart_put((u8)*s++)) return 0; return 1; }
void uart_hex(u8 x) {
    u8 h=x>>4,l=x&15;
    uart_put((u8)(h<10?'0'+h:'A'+h-10));
    uart_put((u8)(l<10?'0'+l:'A'+l-10));
}
sbit EVENT=P3^2;
sbit ALARM=P1^2;
/* Replace only with an authorised test number;not a real destination. */
#define DEST_NUMBER "REPLACE_WITH_AUTHORISED_NUMBER"
/* Timer0Mode1:9216ticks at11.0592MHz12T = nominal10ms,plus reload overhead. */
u8 wait_token(char *token,u16 ticks) {
 u8 pos=0,c;
 TR0=0;TMOD=(TMOD&0xF0)|0x01;TH0=0xDC;TL0=0;TF0=0;TR0=1;
 while(ticks) {
  if(TF0) {TR0=0;TH0=0xDC;TL0=0;TF0=0;TR0=1;--ticks;}
  if(RI) {c=SBUF;RI=0;
   if(c==(u8)token[pos]) {++pos;if(!token[pos]){TR0=0;return 1;}}
   else pos=(c==(u8)token[0])?1:0;
  }
 }
 TR0=0;return 0;
}
volatile u8 message_status=0;
void main(void) {u8 old=1,now,stable;volatile u16 k;
 ALARM=0; EVENT=1;uart_init();
 if(!uart_text("AT\r") || !wait_token("OK",100))message_status=3;
 for(;;) {
 now=EVENT;for(k=0;k<20000;k++) { } stable=EVENT;
 if(now==stable) {
  if(old && !stable) {
   ALARM=1;message_status=1;RI=0;
   if(uart_text("AT+CMGF=1\r") && wait_token("OK",100) &&
      uart_text("AT+CMGS=\"" DEST_NUMBER "\"\r") && wait_token(">",500) &&
      uart_text("Authorised classroom test") && uart_put(26) && wait_token("OK",3000))
        message_status=2;
   else message_status=3;
  }
  if(stable)ALARM=0;old=stable;
 }
 } }

This complete example reserves Timer1 for9600baud and Timer0 for nominal10msnetwork timeout ticks at11.0592MHz;AT/CMGFwait1s,prompt5s,finalOK30s plus reload overhead.The simple token parser is classroom-only and is not a robust production modem driver.

Definition

A light-seeking tracker compares directional light signals and moves a mechanism to reduce their imbalance within travel and safety limits.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Construction:two LDR divider/conditioning channels with a shade separator,approved MUX/ADC,8051,buffered stepper driver,low-voltage motor,limit switches and buffered7segment count display.
  • Working:sample left/right after settling,compute signed error,left−right;inside a deadband hold position,otherwise request one bounded step in the direction defined by calibration.Check end limits before every step and update a bounded software count.
  • Use signed16-bit error to avoid unsigned wrap when left<right;low-light logic can park/hold according to the approved design.Noise filtering/deadband reduce hunting;stall/missed steps require homing or feedback for known position.
  • The sample display shows step-count modulo10,not absolute angle or measured energy gain.This low-voltage model does not justify rooftop mechanical installation or handling a full solar panel.

Complete standalone Keil C51 example

12 MHz classic12T

#include <reg51.h>
typedef unsigned char u8;
typedef unsigned int u16;

void wait_ms(u16 n) {
    TMOD = (TMOD & 0xF0) | 0x01;
    while (n--) {
        TR0=0; TH0=0xFC; TL0=0x18; TF0=0; TR0=1;
        while (!TF0) { }
        TR0=0; TF0=0;
    }
}
sbit ADC_RD=P3^7;
sbit ADC_WR=P3^6;
sbit ADC_INTR=P3^2;
/* ADC data=P1; CS tied LOW; stable conditioned input and valid clock/reference. */
u8 adc_read(u8 *value) {
    u16 timeout=60000u;
    P1=0xFF; ADC_INTR=1; ADC_RD=1;
    ADC_WR=0; wait_ms(1); ADC_WR=1;
    while (ADC_INTR && timeout) { --timeout; }
    if (!timeout) return 0;
    ADC_RD=0; wait_ms(1); *value=P1; ADC_RD=1;
    return 1;
}
const u8 code digits[10]={0x3F,0x06,0x5B,0x4F,0x66,0x6D,0x7D,0x07,0x7F,0x6F};
sbit MXA=P3^0;
sbit MXB=P3^1;
sbit LIMIT_LEFT=P3^3;
sbit LIMIT_RIGHT=P3^4;

 LIMIT_LEFT=1;LIMIT_RIGHT=1;P2=0;P0=0;
 for(;;) {

  MXA=1;wait_ms(2);if(!adc_read(&r)) {P2=0;continue;}
  error=(int)l-(int)r;

  else if(error>3 && LIMIT_RIGHT && position<200) {
    phase=(phase+1)&3;P2=phase_table[phase];++position;wait_ms(20);
  } else if(error< -3 && LIMIT_LEFT && position>0) {
    phase=(phase+3)&3;P2=phase_table[phase];--position;wait_ms(20);
  } else P2=0;
  P0=digits[position%10];wait_ms(50);
 } }
